summary: Updated test files in the app package to reflect the new opaque ProjectStatus and per-extension project service model (extensionId on watchProjectStatus, projectStatuses map, projectOpening object). Updated the registry's protocol package: removed parseUnityProjects, made ProjectStatus opaque, updated the project.status.changed subscription test, then rewrote the registry's extensions package to export a ProjectServiceRegistry and updated its index. Began investigating the registry unity package consumers (unity-view, UnityPanel) for follow-on changes.
decisions: ProjectStatus is opaque (typed `unknown`) at the protocol layer; extensions own validation and shape of status payloads.
WebSocketAgentClient.watchProjectStatus now requires an extensionId argument (e.g. 'unity').
App store tracks per-extension status in store.projectStatuses (e.g. .unity) rather than a single store.projectStatus, and store.projectOpening becomes an object map.
Registry extensions package exposes a ProjectServiceRegistry (replacing CompositeProjectService) that dispatches open/status/watch requests to per-extension ProjectService implementations.
Tests that asserted Editor launch failure interpretation are moved out of the app into the registry unity package, since the registry now owns parsing of opaque results.
WorkspaceInspector test cast: projectOpening shape changed from `false` to `{}` to match the new per-extension loading state.
errors: svelte-check reported 3 pre-existing/unrelated type errors (protocolVersion mismatch in PiExtensionQuestion.test.ts and agent-event-reducer.test.ts) — not introduced by this segment.
vitest run from packages/protocol directory failed to resolve vitest.setup.ts due to config path; resolved by running `npx vitest run packages/protocol` from registry root.

packages/protocol/src/index.test.ts 'validates project status subscriptions and change events' initially failed because the test sent extension-less project.watch; fixed by updating the test to pass extensionId='unity' in the request.
